name: HubSpot

verdict.topBlocker: Unlisted public OAuth apps are capped at 25 installed accounts, so beyond a pilot you need the Marketplace listing, and that requires 3 active installs plus Ecosystem Quality review.
verdict.summary: No HubSpot review is needed before outside customers can connect: create a Projects-based app with distribution set to marketplace, configure OAuth and sign the AUP, and up to 25 accounts can install right away (they see an unverified-app confirmation). Marketplace listing (about 10 business days initial review, up to 60 days total) and later certification are optional and only lift the 25-install cap or add trust; after install, each account gets 110 requests per 10 seconds, 30-minute access tokens and non-expiring refresh tokens.

steps.title: Create a Projects-based app with the HubSpot CLI
steps.detail: Install HubSpot CLI v7.6.0+, run hs account auth, then hs project create (choose App, OAuth auth, distribution 'marketplace'), then hs project upload. Copy the client ID and secret from the app's Auth tab. Legacy UI app creation was disabled in May-June 2026.

steps.title: Configure scopes and redirect URLs in app-hsmeta.json
steps.detail: Set auth.requiredScopes / optionalScopes and auth.redirectUrls in app-hsmeta.json (https in production; http only for localhost; no IP addresses), then run hs project upload. Put non-essential scopes in optional scopes so installs don't fail on lower-tier accounts.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Redirect Flow
steps.detail: Build the backend logic to direct users to the HubSpot authorization endpoint with client ID, redirect URI, and encoded scopes.

steps.title: Exchange authorization code for tokens (v3)
steps.detail: POST URL-form-encoded to https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v3/token with grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri and code in the body. Access tokens expire in 30 minutes; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token.

steps.title: Perform Test Installation and Verification
steps.detail: Install the app in a developer test account as a Super Admin, execute the connection flow, and verify token metadata and logs.

steps.title: Sign the AUP to allow installs in customer accounts
steps.detail: In Development > Projects > your app > Distribution, sign the Acceptable Use Policy. The app can then be installed by up to 25 non-test accounts with no HubSpot review; users see an unverified-app confirmation step.

steps.title: (Optional) Submit Marketplace Listing and Documentation
steps.detail: Complete your marketplace listing details, pricing information, setup documentation links, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy URLs.

steps.title: (Optional) Ecosystem Quality Team Review
steps.detail: Wait for the HubSpot Ecosystem Quality team to review your app listing and compliance criteria, which takes up to 10 business days for initial review.

requirements.note: A HubSpot developer account and associated app are required to retrieve client credentials.
You must review and agree to HubSpot's Technology Partner Program Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy.
Public marketplace listings require live, up-to-date URLs for your app's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
Users installing apps in their HubSpot account must either be a Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace Access permissions.

scopes.note: Grants read access to contact records in the HubSpot CRM.
Grants write access to contact records in the HubSpot CRM.
Base scope required for OAuth authentication flows.

blockers.symptom: Unable to provision apps programmatically via API.
blockers.cause: HubSpot does not support Dynamic Client Registration or API endpoints to create apps; app creation is strictly dashboard-only.
blockers.unblock: Manually create your application in the HubSpot Developer Account console to obtain client ID and client secret.

blockers.symptom: Installation fails with permissions error during testing.
blockers.cause: The user installing the app lacks Super Admin or Marketplace Access permissions, or lacks access to requested scopes.
blockers.unblock: Ensure the installer is a Super Admin in the target HubSpot account.

blockers.symptom: Marketplace submission is rejected or delayed during review.
blockers.cause: Incomplete listing URLs, missing setup documentation, or mismatching pricing information in the submission.
blockers.unblock: Verify that all support, privacy policy, terms, and setup documentation URLs are publicly live and accessible to HubSpot's crawler.

claims.text: HubSpot App Marketplace listing: Any AI agent product expecting more than 25 customer accounts needs it to remove the install cap and the unverified-app warning. It requires 3 active installs, a setup guide, ToS/privacy URLs and the Partner Program Agreement. The wait is 10 business days (about 14 calendar days) for initial review and up to 60 days for the full feedback cycle.
claims.label: sourced
claims.quote: will complete an initial review within 10 business days

claims.text: HubSpot Certified App: Only for vendors wanting a badge and more Marketplace visibility; not needed for OAuth or scale. It requires 6 months listed and 60 active unaffiliated installs, then about 10 business days for the response and up to 60 days of feedback.
claims.label: sourced
claims.quote: must be listed in the HubSpot Marketplace for at least six months

claims.text: Verified domain: Optional for unlisted apps: it shows your domain on the install screen instead of an 'unverified' banner, which builds trust during the 25-install phase. A DNS TXT record usually verifies within an hour, up to 48 hours.
claims.label: sourced
claims.quote: up to 48 hours for the new DNS information to propagate

claims.text: Unlisted marketplace-distributed OAuth apps: max 25 installed accounts (developer test accounts excluded); privately distributed apps: 10 allowlisted accounts: An AI agent product can launch to 25 customer HubSpot accounts without review, but needs the Marketplace listing to grow beyond that, so a listing is practically required at scale.
claims.label: sourced
claims.quote: can be installed in up to 25 accounts (not including developer test accounts)

claims.text: API rate limit for publicly distributed OAuth apps: 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account (CRM Search API excluded and limited separately); the limit-increase add-on does not apply: Agent tool calls must be throttled per customer account, and bursty multi-step agent runs can hit 429s.
claims.label: sourced
claims.quote: each HubSpot account that installs your app is limited to 110 requests every 10 seconds

claims.text: Access tokens last 30 minutes; refresh tokens do not currently expire unless the app is uninstalled or the token is revoked: The agent backend must refresh tokens about every 30 minutes and store refresh tokens securely per tenant.
